name: Bharat Rasayan Limited
remarksWeb: Due to practical difficulty in extinguishment of 102 shares received in Physical form as the Share Certificates are lying at RTA's (i.e., Link Intime India Private Limited) Delhi Office and unfortunately, due to recent surge in the COVID-19 cases, Delhi is under lockdown and only limited movement of individuals and things are allowed for now and all the offices/ work places are shut, an extension in timeline has been sought from SEBI for extinguishment of shares in physical form and we are still awaiting their response on the same. Once the said shares are extinguished, a fresh consolidated Certificate shall be issued.
